title: SCDF Roadshow 2026: Emergency Preparedness & Fire Safety Day
description: A community safety event with hands-on emergency preparedness, life-saving skills, and fire safety activities.

uncertainties: Registration and admission pricing are not stated.

sources.caption:
🚒 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻 𝗹𝗶𝗳𝗲-𝘀𝗮𝘃𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝗸𝗶𝗹𝗹𝘀 𝘁𝗼𝗴𝗲𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗿!

Masjid An-Nur is pleased to partner with the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) for the 𝗦𝗖𝗗𝗙 𝗥𝗼𝗮𝗱𝘀𝗵𝗼𝘄 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲: 𝗘𝗺𝗲𝗿𝗴𝗲𝗻𝗰𝘆 𝗣𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗿𝗲𝗱𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 & 𝗙𝗶𝗿𝗲 𝗦𝗮𝗳𝗲𝘁𝘆 𝗗𝗮𝘆.

Join us for an afternoon of hands-on activities and practical learning to build emergency preparedness, life-saving knowledge, and fire safety awareness in our community.

Learn CPR and basic first aid, get hands-on with an AED, pick up essential fire safety tips, or let your little ones experience being a firefighter for a day.

There’s something for everyone!

📅 𝗧𝗵𝘂𝗿𝘀𝗱𝗮𝘆, 𝟮𝟰 𝗦𝗲𝗽𝘁𝗲𝗺𝗯𝗲𝗿 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲
⏰ 𝟭𝟭 𝗮𝗺 – 𝟰 𝗽𝗺
📍 𝗠𝗮𝘀𝗷𝗶𝗱 𝗔𝗻-𝗡𝘂𝗿 𝗣𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗶𝘀𝗲𝘀

✨ 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗴𝗿𝗮𝗺𝗺𝗲 𝗛𝗶𝗴𝗵𝗹𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁𝘀
- SCDF Responders Plus Programme (RPP)
- Fire Safety Awareness Talk
- SCDF Fire Safety Awareness Booth
- Kids’ Firefighter PPE Experience

Bring your family and friends as we learn, prepare, and play our part in building a safer, more resilient community.

All are welcome! See you there, insyaAllah.
